claims.claim: The synthetic capture/replay and known-truth harness detects the preregistered positive, negative, leakage, and wiring controls in its tested small-model scope.
Scalar Modal K2 can functionally replace one conventional tiny-MoE layer under the frozen v1.3 controlled protocol.
Scalar Modal K2 is superior or non-inferior to conventional narrowing at comparable dominant matrix arithmetic.
limitations: historical teachers not at demonstrated plateau

claims.claim: For the longer-budget top-4 controlled teachers, global scalar expert-axis modes require a non-compute-reducing K to approach the fidelity gate.
Expert-specific low-rank residuals around scalar Modal solve the equal-compute transplant failure.
Router-semantic clustered bases solve the equal-compute transplant failure.

A conventional teacher-informed narrow student retaining about 65% of expert width passes the preregistered cross-entropy fidelity gates in five fresh small teachers and is superior to the 50% comparator.
The shared-base plus bilateral expert-specific rank-5 residual architecture can meet absolute cross-entropy gates under a strongly compressed analytical budget in controlled screens.
limitations: absolute CE is not behavioral preservation

claims.claim: The post-hoc shared-base bilateral low-rank family is non-inferior or superior to narrow65 in behavioral fidelity.
claims.independent_check: v1-v4 audits plus Reality Gate 1A audit

claims.claim: Routing-set counterfactual supervision materially improves selected error-geometry endpoints over expert-wise supervision.
limitations: absolute KL, top-1, local and counterfactual fidelity remained poor

claims.claim: The v4 route-set moment correction has a causal effect on KL after training.
limitations: second moment did not beat mean-only

claims.claim: Reality Gate 1A used an immutable official WikiText-2 revision, article-level statistical units, train-only tokenizer fitting, and heldout arrays opened only after candidate freeze.
limitations: WikiText-2 is a small data regime
OOD set is deterministic and small

claims.claim: All eight scientific Reality Gate 1A teachers reached the frozen plateau criterion.
claims.independent_check: independent reconstruction of plateau status and teacher histories
limitations: a longer separately preregistered maturity study could establish later plateau

claims.claim: Static spectral heterogeneous rank improves over uniform rank at matched parameter and expected-compute budgets in Reality Gate 1A.
limitations: scientific teachers did not reach plateau
spectral utility tested, not every possible utility

claims.claim: The Reality Gate 1A spectral allocator discovers material rank heterogeneity under the frozen budgets.
claims.independent_check: persisted rank vectors and independent budget reconstruction
limitations: one small-scale seed produced a minimal redistribution
other architectures may create different utility landscapes

claims.claim: Spectral marginal utility adds established value beyond routing frequency alone in Reality Gate 1A.
The Reality Gate residual expert matrices exhibit slow spectral decay relative to the executed low-rank budgets.
claims.independent_check: trajectory effective-rank summaries across four seeds and two scales
limitations: weight-space energy is not a complete functional metric

claims.claim: The current static utility evidence justifies implementing a dynamic per-token rank controller as the next primary experiment.
claims.independent_check: Reality Gate 1A stop rule and adversarial review
limitations: a materially different native-training regime may later justify dynamic control

claims.claim: Heterogeneous rank can never help MoE compression.
limitations: Reality Gate tested one spectral formulation and one routing-only control

claims.claim: The current student family is ready for an OLMoE or Qwen checkpoint transplant.
claims.independent_check: canonical gate status plus current independent audit
limitations: a materially different native architecture may change the conclusion
